name: Put/call extreme with retail fear confluence (options+spot consensus pessimism, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: putcall_ratio is a PROFESSIONAL/informed-money positioning gauge — options are traded by sharper participants than the fear_greed crowd. An extreme put/call spike = heavy downside hedging among sophisticated players; when it hits a tail AND retail spot sentiment (fear_greed) is ALSO extreme, you get consensus pessimism that historically over-hedges: puts get bid up, spot gets a fear discount, and the hedge unwind (expiry/roll-off) provides mechanical buy pressure. The confluence of informed AND retail pessimism is the specific edge (either alone is noisier). Long spot; exit when put/call normalizes down or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: putcall_ratio coverage is likely BTC/ETH-only and short-history — verify per-symbol effective-N BEFORE anything or it cannot clear FDR. Mechanism check: if high put/call does NOT precede positive spot returns once you control for fear_greed (redundant with the fear composite, or sign corrupted by cash-secured-put yield flows), there is no independent options-sentiment edge — kill.
catalyst: extreme put/call hedging alongside extreme retail fear
